subject: We Received Your Message | Veritas Mobile Car Detailing
snippet:
Thank you for contacting Veritas Mobile Car Detailing.

 

We received your message and a member of our Detail Concierge team will get back to you as soon as possible.

 

If you’re requesting a quote, please include your vehicle’s year, make, model, your location, and the service you’re interested in. Photos are also helpful if there are specific areas you’d like us to address.

 

In the meantime, you can view our detailing services or book online at https://veritasdetailing.site

 

We appreciate the opportunity to earn your business.

 

Detail Concierge

Veritas Mobile Car Detailing

subject: Re: quick question for Dependency re onestoptaxhelp.com
snippet: Thank you for your message! We have received your email and a team member will respond within 24-48 hours. During peak tax season, response times may extend slightly. Please note: For security reasons, we are unable to open or review documents sent by email. All documents must be uploaded through your secure client portal. This ensures your information is protected and routed to the correct team member. If your message is urgent, please contact our office directly at (480) 663-7867. For the fastest response, clients are encouraged to message us through their portal: https://onestoptaxhelp.taxdome.com/login. We are excited to announce some updates to better serve you: Our office is fully operational in our new suite #209 (upstairs-there is an elevator). For an overview of our services, check out this informative video: New Beginnings Services Video: https://youtu.be/b7y6o4gCBv0?si=o6-MutAKzVMqQ7A8 We highly recommend viewing our service-specific videos, which include detailed information and pricing for our main services: Individual Tax Preparation Video: https://youtu.be/2Ph-9rudx5k Small Business Solutions Video: https://youtu.be/J4OMgex6Y3c Tax Resolution Video with Pricing: https://youtu.be/vcZekQY6uiw Current Office Hours: During tax season (January to April), our office hours are Monday to Friday, 9 am - 5 pm. Outside of tax season (May to December), our hours are Monday to Thursday, 9 am - 5 pm. We continue to offer In Office and Virtual Appointments. Virtual appointments are via Zoom or phone. For In-Office and drop-off of documents, please schedule an appointment in advance to ensure we can accommodate your needs.
